拜託大廚多把關菜品，拜託把地下車場味道和衞生搞起來……
translatedContent: Breakfast was absolutely awful! Is it because there are so many foreigners? The Chinese food didn't taste like Chinese food, and the Western food didn't taste like Western food either 😩 Many of the fried dumplings were broken, and even after I told the chef, he didn't respond. The wontons weren't freshly made, and the broth was bland. There was also a large counter constantly juicing fruits and vegetables, which was incredibly noisy. Haven't we already debunked the myth that you should eat fresh vegetables instead of drinking juice? And the vegetables were all displayed whole—is it really that much trouble to cut them? It felt like buying groceries at a market… The food and quality are simply not up to par for a star-rated hotel 😭 The room was okay. But I also have to complain about the parking: you have to pay if you park for more than 24 hours. So even if I don't move all day, I have to drive out and back in? Why didn't they remind us when we checked in? I ended up paying over 100 yuan for parking because I only booked this hotel because parking was free. Besides, the underground parking garage smelled strongly of sewage, the air was stale, and the walls on both sides of the entrance and exit were covered in stains and dust. It makes me wonder how good the hotel and its management can be… Please, chef, pay more attention to the food, and please fix the smell and cleanliness of the underground parking garage…

content:
這次入住訂的行政大床房，先説尚可的地方：房間面積夠寬敞，不會壓抑；全屋衞生打掃得中規中矩，沒發現污漬死角；床品軟硬適中，睡起來不算難受，基礎住宿底線是穩住了。
槽點集中在餐飲這塊，體驗落差特別大。
早餐衹能説平平無奇，亮點很少，最大硬傷是餐廳長條佈局，取餐區拆得特別散，拿個熱菜、飲品來回要走將近一百米，來回折騰特別費腿，高峯期端着餐走路也不方便。
最失望的是行政酒廊，完全達不到萬豪行政禮遇該有的水準。好多小朋友直接把這裏當成遊樂場，追逐吵鬧，全程沒有工作人員上前勸阻，安安靜靜歇會兒根本做不到。餐食、酒水、飲料、水果的供應量特別少，種類單薄，補給也慢，花行政房的價格，酒廊體驗實在拉胯，性價比大打折扣。
translatedContent:
I booked an Executive King Room for this stay. Let me start with the acceptable points: the room size was spacious enough, not cramped; the overall cleanliness was decent, I didn't find any dirty spots; the bedding was neither too soft nor too hard, so sleeping wasn't uncomfortable. The basic accommodation baseline was met.

The main complaints are concentrated in the dining area, where the experience was particularly disappointing.

Breakfast was just mediocre, with very few highlights. The biggest drawback was the long, narrow layout of the restaurant, with the food stations spread out. Getting a hot dish or a drink meant walking almost a hundred meters back and forth, which was quite tiring. During peak hours, carrying food around was also inconvenient.

The biggest letdown was the Executive Lounge. It simply didn't meet the standards expected of Marriott's executive benefits. Many children treated it like a playground, chasing and making noise. No staff member ever stepped in to intervene, making it impossible to relax quietly. The supply of food, alcoholic beverages, non-alcoholic drinks, and fruit was very limited, the variety was poor, and replenishment was slow. Paying executive room prices for such a subpar lounge experience significantly reduced the value for money.
